visual-headings-without-heading-markup.why: Canonical F2: each visual heading must be programmatically determinable.

data-table-missing-or-suppressed-semanti.why: role=presentation fails table identification; all-td tables fail cell-header association.

layout-table-fabricating-data-semantics.why: Layout table asserting th/caption/scope/role=table is exactly the 14.C condition.

structural-markup-misused-for-presentati.why: Heading-for-emphasis: programmatic heading isn't a real visual heading (10.B note); blockquote/fieldset misuse uncovered.

visual-lists-without-list-markup.why: Visually apparent lists must be programmatically identified by correct type and nesting.

ascii-and-pre-faux-tables-and-columns.why: ANDI detects no table/list in pre/whitespace text, so no TT test isolates it.

emulated-controls-wrong-or-missing-role.why: Wrong/missing control role is a 4.1.2 issue; no 1.3.1 TT test isolates it.

form-label-and-group-relationships-by-co.why: Programmatic label/group/cue association of form fields is exactly the 5.C condition.

special-status-text-conveyed-only-by-sty.why: Emphasis/status by styling (G117/H49) has no isolating TT test in this SC.
